en: Black-and-white image of an interior museum exhibition room. The room contains display cases, weapons, tools, barrels, and a mannequin dressed in a dark military or official uniform with equipment hanging from its belt. Large painted panels or dioramas on the back wall depict historical scenes involving vehicles and possibly industrial or transport themes. The ceiling has simple hanging lights. An arched doorway in the back wall bears a sign above it, and various objects are arranged around the room as if for a historical or technical exhibition.
